title: Task dashboard
prompt: Give me a dashboard of my task list: the key numbers as Stats, a Meter for how much is done, and a Kanban Board with Open and Done columns. Use live data from the tools.
lang:
root = Card([header, stats, meter, sep, board, actions, followups])
summary = Query("task_summary", {}, {"total":0,"open":0,"done":0,"percent_done":0,"open_by_priority":{"low":0,"medium":0,"high":0}})
openTasks = Query("list_tasks", {status: "open"}, {rows: []})
doneTasks = Query("list_tasks", {status: "done"}, {rows: []})
header = CardHeader("Task dashboard", "Live overview of your team's task list")
stats = Stats([statTotal, statOpen, statDone, statHigh])
statTotal = Stat("" + summary.total, "Total tasks")
statOpen = Stat("" + summary.open, "Open")
statDone = Stat("" + summary.done, "Done")
statHigh = Stat("" + summary.open_by_priority.high, "Open high priority")
meter = Meter("Tasks done", summary.done, summary.total, summary.percent_done + "% complete")
sep = Separator()
board = Board([openCol, doneCol])
openCol = Column("Open", openTasks.rows.title, openTasks.rows.priority)
doneCol = Column("Done", doneTasks.rows.title, doneTasks.rows.priority)
actions = Buttons([refreshBtn])
refreshBtn = Button("Refresh", Action([@Run(summary), @Run(openTasks), @Run(doneTasks)]), "secondary")
followups = FollowUpBlock([f1, f2, f3])
f1 = FollowUpItem("Add a new task")
f2 = FollowUpItem("Show only high priority open tasks")
f3 = FollowUpItem("Mark a task as done")

title: Task details
prompt: Let me pick a task from a dropdown and show its details as Facts. Add buttons to complete it, reopen it and delete it, and show all tasks on a Timeline by creation date. Use live data from the tools.
lang:
root = Card([header, pickerForm, details, actions, statusMsg, sep, timelineHeader, timeline])
$taskId = ""
tasks = Query("list_tasks", {}, {rows: []})
task = Query("get_task", {id: $taskId}, {task: {id: 0, title: "", priority: "", status: "", created_at: ""}})
completeRes = Mutation("update_task", {id: $taskId, status: "done"})
reopenRes = Mutation("update_task", {id: $taskId, status: "open"})
deleteRes = Mutation("delete_task", {id: $taskId})
header = CardHeader("Task details", "Pick a task to view, complete, reopen or delete it")
pickerForm = Form("picker", pickerBtns, [pickerField])
pickerField = FormControl("Task", Select("taskId", @Each(tasks.rows, "t", SelectItem("" + t.id, t.title)), "Select a task", null, $taskId))
pickerBtns = Buttons([refreshBtn])
refreshBtn = Button("Refresh", Action([@Run(tasks), @Run(task)]), "secondary")
details = $taskId ? Facts(["Title", "Priority", "Status", "Created", "ID"], [task.task.title, task.task.priority, task.task.status, task.task.created_at, task.task.id]) : TextContent("Select a task above to see its details.", "small")
actions = $taskId ? Buttons([completeBtn, reopenBtn, deleteBtn]) : null
completeBtn = Button("Complete", Action([@Run(completeRes), @Run(task), @Run(tasks)]), "primary")
reopenBtn = Button("Reopen", Action([@Run(reopenRes), @Run(task), @Run(tasks)]), "secondary")
deleteBtn = Button("Delete", Action([@Run(deleteRes), @Reset($taskId), @Run(tasks)]), "secondary", "destructive")
statusMsg = completeRes.status == "loading" || reopenRes.status == "loading" || deleteRes.status == "loading" ? TextContent("Saving...", "small") : null
sep = Separator()
timelineHeader = InlineHeader("All tasks", "Ordered by creation date")
sortedTasks = @Sort(tasks.rows, "created_at", "asc")
timeline = Timeline(sortedTasks.created_at, sortedTasks.title, @Each(sortedTasks, "s", s.priority + " priority · " + s.status))

title: Add and triage tasks
prompt: Let me add a new task with a title and a priority. Below the form, show the open tasks in a table and a Board with one column per priority, and refresh them after adding. Add a way to mark a chosen task done. Use live data from the tools.
lang:
root = Card([header, addForm, addStatus, Separator(), tableHeader, taskTable, boardHeader, board, Separator(), doneHeader, doneForm, doneStatus])
$title = ""
$priority = "medium"
$doneId = ""
openTasks = Query("list_tasks", {status: "open"}, {rows: []})
addResult = Mutation("add_task", {title: $title, priority: $priority})
doneResult = Mutation("update_task", {id: $doneId, status: "done"})
header = CardHeader("Team tasks", "Add tasks, track open work by priority, and mark tasks done")
addForm = Form("addTask", addButtons, [titleField, priorityField])
titleField = FormControl("Title", Input("title", "What needs doing?", "text", {required: true, maxLength: 120}, $title))
priorityField = FormControl("Priority", Select("priority", [SelectItem("low", "Low"), SelectItem("medium", "Medium"), SelectItem("high", "High")], "Choose a priority", {required: true}, $priority))
addButtons = Buttons([addBtn])
addBtn = Button("Add task", Action([@Run(addResult), @Run(openTasks), @Reset($title, $priority)]), "primary")
addStatus = addResult.status == "loading" ? TextContent("Adding task...", "small") : addResult.status == "error" ? Callout("error", "Could not add task", addResult.error) : null
tableHeader = InlineHeader("Open tasks", @Count(openTasks.rows) + " open")
taskTable = Table([Col("ID", openTasks.rows.id, "number"), Col("Title", openTasks.rows.title), Col("Priority", openTasks.rows.priority), Col("Created", openTasks.rows.created_at)])
boardHeader = InlineHeader("By priority", "Open tasks grouped by priority")
board = Board([highCol, mediumCol, lowCol])
highCol = Column("High", @Filter(openTasks.rows, "priority", "==", "high").title)
mediumCol = Column("Medium", @Filter(openTasks.rows, "priority", "==", "medium").title)
lowCol = Column("Low", @Filter(openTasks.rows, "priority", "==", "low").title)
doneHeader = InlineHeader("Complete a task", "Pick an open task and mark it done")
doneForm = Form("markDone", doneButtons, [doneField])
doneField = FormControl("Task", Select("doneId", @Each(openTasks.rows, "t", SelectItem("" + t.id, t.title)), "Choose an open task", {required: true}, $doneId))
doneButtons = Buttons([doneBtn])
doneBtn = Button("Mark done", Action([@Run(doneResult), @Run(openTasks), @Reset($doneId)]), "secondary")
doneStatus = doneResult.status == "loading" ? TextContent("Updating...", "small") : doneResult.status == "error" ? Callout("error", "Could not update task", doneResult.error) : null

title: Weekly report
prompt: Write a weekly status report for my task list: summary numbers as Stats, a Meter for percent done, the tasks on a Timeline by creation date with their priority, and a Facts panel with the totals per priority. Use live data from the tools.
lang:
root = Card([header, stats, meter, sep1, timelineHeader, timeline, sep2, factsHeader, facts, actions, followups])
summary = Query("task_summary", {}, {total: 0, open: 0, done: 0, percent_done: 0, open_by_priority: {low: 0, medium: 0, high: 0}})
tasks = Query("list_tasks", {}, {rows: []})
sorted = @Sort(tasks.rows, "created_at", "asc")
header = CardHeader("Weekly status report", "Live snapshot of your team's task list")
stats = Stats([statTotal, statOpen, statDone, statHigh])
statTotal = Stat("" + summary.total, "Total tasks")
statOpen = Stat("" + summary.open, "Open")
statDone = Stat("" + summary.done, "Completed")
statHigh = Stat("" + summary.open_by_priority.high, "Open high priority")
meter = Meter("Percent done", @Round(summary.percent_done, 0), 100, summary.done + " of " + summary.total + " tasks completed")
sep1 = Separator()
timelineHeader = InlineHeader("Tasks by creation date", "Each task with its priority and status")
timeline = Timeline(sorted.created_at, sorted.title, @Each(sorted, "t", "Priority: " + t.priority + " · Status: " + t.status))
sep2 = Separator()
factsHeader = InlineHeader("Open tasks per priority", "Breakdown of work still to do")
facts = Facts(["High", "Medium", "Low", "Total open"], [summary.open_by_priority.high, summary.open_by_priority.medium, summary.open_by_priority.low, summary.open])
actions = Buttons([refreshBtn])
refreshBtn = Button("Refresh data", Action([@Run(summary), @Run(tasks)]), "secondary")
followups = FollowUpBlock([fu1, fu2, fu3])
fu1 = FollowUpItem("Show only open high-priority tasks")
fu2 = FollowUpItem("Add a new task")
fu3 = FollowUpItem("Summarize risks for next week")

title: Launch roadmap
prompt: Plan a six-week launch roadmap for a small SaaS product, with made-up data and no tools: a Timeline of milestones, a Facts panel with the key launch details, a Meter per workstream, and a Board of workstreams by status.
lang:
root = Card([header, stats, timelineHeader, timeline, factsHeader, facts, metersHeader, m1, m2, m3, m4, boardHeader, board, actions, followUps])

header = CardHeader("Six-week launch roadmap", "Pulse Analytics v1.0 — public launch plan")

stats = Stats([Stat("6 weeks", "Time to launch"), Stat("4", "Workstreams"), Stat("58%", "Overall progress"), Stat("12", "Open tasks")])

timelineHeader = InlineHeader("Milestones", "Key checkpoints from kickoff to public launch")
timeline = Timeline(["2025-03-03", "2025-03-10", "2025-03-17", "2025-03-24", "2025-03-31", "2025-04-07", "2025-04-14"], ["Kickoff & scope freeze", "Private beta opens", "Pricing & billing live", "Marketing site ready", "Public beta & press outreach", "Launch readiness review", "Public launch"], ["Finalize v1 feature list and assign owners", "Invite 50 design partners to the beta", "Stripe integration with three pricing tiers", "Landing page, docs and demo video published", "Open signups, pitch 20 newsletters and blogs", "Go/no-go meeting across all workstreams", "Product Hunt launch and announcement email"])

factsHeader = InlineHeader("Launch details", "The essentials at a glance")
facts = Facts(["Product", "Launch date", "Launch owner", "Target audience", "Pricing", "Launch channel", "Signup goal", "Budget"], ["Pulse Analytics v1.0", "Monday, April 14", "Maya Chen", "Seed-stage SaaS founders", "Free, $29/mo, $99/mo", "Product Hunt + email list", "500 signups in week one", "$8,000"])

metersHeader = InlineHeader("Workstream progress", "Share of tasks completed per workstream")
m1 = Meter("Product & engineering", 75, 100, "15 of 20 tasks done")
m2 = Meter("Marketing", 50, 100, "6 of 12 tasks done")
m3 = Meter("Sales & pricing", 60, 100, "3 of 5 tasks done")
m4 = Meter("Support & docs", 40, 100, "4 of 10 tasks done")

boardHeader = InlineHeader("Workstreams by status", "Current deliverables, tagged by workstream")
board = Board([colTodo, colProgress, colReview, colDone])
colTodo = Column("To do", ["Press kit", "Launch day runbook", "Help center FAQ", "Product Hunt assets"], ["Marketing", "Product", "Support", "Marketing"])
colProgress = Column("In progress", ["Onboarding flow", "Demo video", "Billing edge cases", "API docs"], ["Product", "Marketing", "Sales", "Support"])
colReview = Column("In review", ["Landing page copy", "Pricing page", "Email sequence"], ["Marketing", "Sales", "Marketing"])
colDone = Column("Done", ["Scope freeze", "Beta invites sent", "Stripe integration", "Analytics tracking"], ["Product", "Marketing", "Sales", "Product"])

actions = Buttons([Button("Draft launch-day runbook", @ToAssistant("Draft a launch-day runbook for Pulse Analytics"), "primary"), Button("Identify risks", @ToAssistant("What are the biggest risks in this launch roadmap?"), "secondary")])

followUps = FollowUpBlock([FollowUpItem("Write the Product Hunt launch post"), FollowUpItem("Build a week-by-week task checklist"), FollowUpItem("Suggest launch KPIs to track")])

title: Filter tasks
prompt: Build a task browser with live filters: a Select for status (all, open, done) and a Select for priority (all, low, medium, high), each bound to a $variable. The list_tasks Query must use the status filter as its argument so it re-runs when the filter changes, and the priority filter narrows the rows. Show how many tasks match, the matching tasks in a Table, and a Board with one column per priority. Use live data from the tools.
lang:
root = Card([header, filters, stats, tableHeader, taskTable, boardHeader, board, refreshBtns])
$status = "all"
$priority = "all"
tasks = Query("list_tasks", {status: $status == "all" ? null : $status}, {rows: []})
rows = $priority == "all" ? tasks.rows : @Filter(tasks.rows, "priority", "==", $priority)
header = CardHeader("Task browser", "Filter live tasks by status and priority")
filters = Form("filters", filterBtns, [statusField, priorityField])
filterBtns = Buttons([resetBtn])
resetBtn = Button("Reset filters", Action([@Reset($status, $priority)]), "secondary")
statusField = FormControl("Status", Select("status", [SelectItem("all", "All"), SelectItem("open", "Open"), SelectItem("done", "Done")], null, null, $status))
priorityField = FormControl("Priority", Select("priority", [SelectItem("all", "All"), SelectItem("low", "Low"), SelectItem("medium", "Medium"), SelectItem("high", "High")], null, null, $priority))
stats = Stats([Stat("" + @Count(rows), "Matching tasks"), Stat("" + @Count(@Filter(rows, "priority", "==", "high")), "High priority"), Stat("" + @Count(@Filter(rows, "status", "==", "open")), "Open")])
tableHeader = InlineHeader("Matching tasks", "Rows from list_tasks, narrowed by priority")
taskTable = Table([Col("ID", rows.id, "number"), Col("Title", rows.title), Col("Priority", rows.priority), Col("Status", rows.status), Col("Created", rows.created_at)])
boardHeader = InlineHeader("By priority", "Matching tasks grouped into one column per priority")
board = Board([colHigh, colMedium, colLow])
colHigh = Column("High", @Filter(rows, "priority", "==", "high").title, @Filter(rows, "priority", "==", "high").status)
colMedium = Column("Medium", @Filter(rows, "priority", "==", "medium").title, @Filter(rows, "priority", "==", "medium").status)
colLow = Column("Low", @Filter(rows, "priority", "==", "low").title, @Filter(rows, "priority", "==", "low").status)
refreshBtns = Buttons([Button("Refresh", Action([@Run(tasks)]), "secondary")])

title: Explore by priority
prompt: Make a priority explorer: three buttons (High, Medium, Low) that set a $priority variable with @Set, with the chosen one shown as selected. Stats and a Meter follow the chosen priority: how many open tasks have it and what share of all open tasks that is. Below, list the open tasks with that priority. Use live data from the tools.
lang:
root = Card([header, btns, stats, meter, listHeader, taskTable, follow])
$priority = "high"
openTasks = Query("list_tasks", {status: "open"}, {rows: []})
header = CardHeader("Priority explorer", "Open tasks for the selected priority")
btns = Buttons([highBtn, medBtn, lowBtn], "row")
highBtn = Button("High", @Set($priority, "high"), $priority == "high" ? "primary" : "secondary")
medBtn = Button("Medium", @Set($priority, "medium"), $priority == "medium" ? "primary" : "secondary")
lowBtn = Button("Low", @Set($priority, "low"), $priority == "low" ? "primary" : "secondary")
filtered = @Filter(openTasks.rows, "priority", "==", $priority)
matchCount = @Count(filtered)
openCount = @Count(openTasks.rows)
share = openCount > 0 ? @Round(matchCount / openCount * 100) : 0
stats = Stats([Stat("" + matchCount, "Open " + $priority + " tasks"), Stat("" + openCount, "All open tasks"), Stat(share + "%", "Share of open tasks")])
meter = Meter("Share of open tasks that are " + $priority, share, 100, matchCount + " of " + openCount + " open tasks")
listHeader = InlineHeader("Open " + $priority + " tasks", matchCount == 0 ? "No open tasks with this priority" : "Sorted by newest first")
sorted = @Sort(filtered, "created_at", "desc")
taskTable = Table([Col("ID", sorted.id, "number"), Col("Title", sorted.title), Col("Created", sorted.created_at)])
follow = FollowUpBlock([FollowUpItem("Add a new high priority task"), FollowUpItem("Show completed tasks")])
